sources.name: march-s
sources.annotationMethod: Fresh manual concealed pelvis-center X projected to independently visible supporting boot sole Y in each cell; a2D registration pivot, not certified pelvis reconstruction or recovered physical ground. Fresh visually selected alpha>=64 boot-only ROIs for the leading/supporting imageRIGHT boot in TL/TR and imageLEFT boot in BL/BR; exclusive bottom Y measured separately in every cell. Upright weapon, lifted/trailing boot and torso pixels are excluded. Rounded median of four fresh cap-to-individual-supporting-sole spans; one whole-source scale, no per-phase scaling.
limitations: Acceptance binds only to this exactSHA and allfour inspected cells for localoptin preview.
Four discrete native poses are not skeletal/continuous animation or proof of historical marching drill and foot contact.
Contact depth/heel-to-ground assignment, hidden pelvis, fingers and approximate supporting sole remain uncertain.
Native cap-to-supporting-sole spans vary by10pixels; one whole-source height329 retains the variation without per-phase normalization.
Source is drawn smaller in its native627cells than S actions; runtime scale comes from separately measured sourceheight, while final renderer clarity/temporal behavior remains tobe checked.
Low-alpha colored RGB residue remains; targeted alpha criteria do not prove perfectly clean transparency or absence of every fringe color.
Model-assisted review, not human, anatomy, historical equipment/drill, default, production or complete-family certification.
Runtime phase timing, turns, pause/checkpoint geometry, decoded/GPU/process residency and device performance remain separate checks.
sources.scope: Exact historical Gettysburg v14 local opt-in only; no default, full-family or production approval

sources.name: actions-s
sources.annotationMethod: Fresh manual concealed pelvis-center X projected to independently selected visible supporting boot sole Y in each cell. A 2D registration pivot, not recovered certified anatomical pelvis or physical ground. Fresh visually selected alpha>=64 supporting-boot-only ROIs; root Y uses the exclusive bottom in each ROI. Ready/loading ROIs exclude the rifle butt: TL source-wide bottom583 is not used because boot-only sole is582; BL source-wide bottom568 is not used because selected boot sole is566. Paired planted boots and camera depth leave about3-pixel uncertainty. Rounded median of four fresh cap-to-individual-supporting-sole spans; one whole-source scale and no per-phase scaling.
limitations: Acceptance binds only to this exact source SHA and all four inspected cells for local opt-in preview.
Four stationary poses do not establish verified historical loading/ramming drill or smooth ready-to-aim/loading transitions.
Hidden pelvis, fingertips, shoulder stock attachment and 2D supporting-foot ground estimates remain uncertain.
Native cap-to-supporting-sole spans vary by19pixels; the whole-source height502 retains variation.
Targeted red/yellow pixel test does not establish perfectly clean alpha or exhaustive absence of fringe.
Model-assisted review, not human, physical anatomy, historical equipment/drill, default, production or complete-family certification.
Temporal renderer, pauses/checkpoints, smoke lifetime, decoded/GPU/process residency and device performance remain separate checks.
